text:
Maya (CS): Heads up — ClearVector procurement asked for a 1-page SLA/SLO summary and a worked example showing credits if P99 latency > 300ms. Need by EOD.
Jamal (AE): Theyre evaluating renewal sensitivity; simple numbers please. Procurement likes concrete examples not legalese.
Priya (CS Ops): OK I can draft. Confirming contract SLOs: 99.9% monthly uptime and P99 <= 300ms for inference endpoint. Theyre scheduled to move to Dedicated in ~8 weeks.
Ethan (SRE): Confirmed. Data lives in prod-west. I'll pull a 30d baseline and a 7d rolling P99. Quick PromQL to share: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{customer="clearvector"}[1m])) by (le))` aggregated into daily points.
Maya (CS): Two asks: (A) short explanation of how uptime is computed (we only count successful customer traffic to inference API), (B) worked credit example with numbers. Keep it digestible.
Priya (CS Ops): Drafting now. Plan: one section for uptime calc, one for latency calc (P99 definition + query), one sample credit table, and an evidence bundle link.
Jamal (AE): Procurement will press on "how we compute credits". Make credit formula explicit. Example wording: `credit = ((SLO_threshold - measured_value)/SLO_threshold) * monthly_fee` ? Need legal to vet.
Nadia (Legal): Prefer standard phrasing. Suggest: "Credit = (SLA% - Actual%)*MonthlyFee/100" and a line: "SLA credits are the exclusive monetary remedy for outages under the Agreement." Send draft for redline.
ops-bot: Deployment note: dedicated-migration scheduled job created by @Priya 12026-04-25.
Ethan (SRE): I'll attach a sample chart. Also flag: on 2026-03-04 we had a 22m partial region blip; I'll include that incident summary and remediation notes.
Priya (CS Ops): Uploaded first pass: https://drive.redwood/clearvector/sla-onepager-v1 (view). Sample credit table inside:
- Monthly fee: $12,000
- SLA uptime target: 99.9%
- Example: If actual uptime = 99.5% -> delta = 0.4% -> credit = 0.004 * $12,000 = $48
I will also add a worked latency example: if P99 = 450ms (target 300ms) show proportional credit.
Maya (CS): Small tweak: show credits as both $ and % of invoice, procurement likes both. Also show mitigation options: regional failover, model-variant fallback, Dedicated migration ETA.
Jamal (AE): I'll prep procurement email template once legal signs off.
Nadia (Legal): Reviewed. Minor language tweak: "SLA credits constitute the sole monetary remedy for Service Unavailability under this Agreement." Ok to publish.
Priya (CS Ops): Updated doc and posted final link: https://drive.redwood/clearvector/sla-onepager-final. Added PromQL snippets and the P99 chart (PNG).
Ethan (SRE): Chart attached in drive, and Prometheus query included: `max_over_time(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{customer="clearvector"}[5m])) by (le))[7d:1d])`
Maya (CS): Great work team. Timeline closed: send to procurement after 17:45. I'll follow up with ClearVector once they ack. :thumbsup:
